project_context: Boundary-Aware Claim Evaluation of historical ESRS-style disclosures generated by a fixed evidence-card RAG workflow

standard_basis.version_policy: Use the same 2023 requirement definitions as the existing E1 tasks. Do not interpret these identifiers using the renumbered 2026 revision.

design_notes.purpose: Research proposal for four tasks per standard; not a frozen or activated runtime configuration.
selection_principles: A mix of narrative and quantitative content
No selection based on BACE-comparator score differences
design_notes.historical_interpretation: 2019-2023 cases are ESRS-style simulations, not claims that these reports were legally subject to ESRS.
design_notes.missing_evidence_policy: Distinguish explicit absence, explicit zero, non-disclosure, unavailable source, and retrieval failure. Missing evidence does not establish that a policy, target, incident or action does not exist.
design_notes.source_quality_policy: CSV metrics are eligible only after their meaning, population, period, unit and source passage have been checked. Existing extracted cells are discovery aids, not ground truth.
design_notes.temporal_policy: Freeze document eligibility and publication cutoff before retrieval. Do not import later policies or targets into earlier cases. Preserve observation year and source-publication year separately.
design_notes.generation_policy: Use the same shared generation instructions across E1, S1 and G1. Task risk notes are researcher metadata, not evaluator-specific hints for the generator.
design_notes.implementation_note: These files follow the existing task-spec field structure. Extra research metadata does not implement source checks, missingness handling or runtime integration.

tasks.task_scope: Adopted workforce policies, their covered populations, labour and human-rights commitments, non-discrimination, equal opportunities, and occupational safety policy.
tasks.task_selection_rationale: Tests whether policy existence, applicability and commitments remain grounded. Its focus is policy content and coverage; action implementation belongs to S1-4.
tasks.official_requirement_basis: 2023 Annex I, ESRS S1, paragraphs 17-24. Policies related to own workforce.
tasks.evidence_availability_rationale: Historical human-resources, human-rights and safety sections are plausible narrative sources. Supplier-only policies cannot establish coverage of own workforce.
tasks.retrieval_intent: Find company- and reporting-year-specific source passages and tables about adopted workforce policies, their covered populations, labour and human-rights commitments, non-discrimination, equal opportunities, and occupational safety policy.
tasks.generation_intent: Draft an ESRS S1-style disclosure section about policies related to own workforce using only evidence supplied for the case, preserving its factual qualifications.
claim_risk_notes: Do not transfer supplier-worker policies to own workforce.
A policy commitment is not demonstrated implementation or effectiveness.
Do not extend a policy covering employees to all non-employees or all countries.
Do not infer alignment with international instruments from a generic commitment.
Do not infer policy absence from missing retrieved evidence.

tasks.task_name: Actions, resources and effectiveness related to own workforce
tasks.task_scope: Actions taken, underway or planned to address own-workforce impacts, risks and opportunities; resources, remediation, and evidenced methods or results for assessing effectiveness.
tasks.task_selection_rationale: Tests implementation status, attribution, resources and claimed outcomes in workforce management. Routine training is included only when linked to a workforce impact, risk or opportunity.
tasks.official_requirement_basis: 2023 Annex I, ESRS S1, paragraphs 35-43. Actions, resources and effectiveness related to own workforce.
tasks.evidence_availability_rationale: Historical workforce development, occupational health, inclusion, restructuring and employee-wellbeing narratives can provide action evidence. Numerical resource claims need a traceable table or passage.
tasks.retrieval_intent: Find company- and reporting-year-specific source passages and tables about actions taken, underway or planned to address own-workforce impacts, risks and opportunities; resources, remediation, and evidenced methods or results for assessing effectiveness.
tasks.generation_intent: Draft an ESRS S1-style disclosure section about actions, resources and effectiveness related to own workforce using only evidence supplied for the case, preserving its factual qualifications.
claim_risk_notes: Do not turn planned activities into completed actions.
Do not infer causal improvement from participation or expenditure alone.
Do not assign a group-wide resource total to one workforce programme.
Do not treat a policy statement as evidence that an action occurred.
Separate workforce-development training from anti-corruption controls under G1-3.

tasks.task_name: Targets related to own-workforce impacts, risks and opportunities
tasks.task_scope: Time-bound and outcome-oriented workforce targets actually disclosed, including diversity or safety targets, baselines where stated, target dates, population boundaries, progress, and worker involvement in target setting.
tasks.task_selection_rationale: Retains a substantive forward-looking workforce task. Both the 2023 standard and historical company reports support it; the selection is not based solely on symmetry with E1.
tasks.official_requirement_basis: 2023 Annex I, ESRS S1, paragraphs 44-47; ESRS 2 MDR-T paragraphs 78-81. Targets related to own-workforce impacts, risks and opportunities.
tasks.evidence_availability_rationale: BASF 2023 discloses a 2030 target for women in leadership and a safety target. This establishes plausibility, not prevalence across the final sample. Targets require narrative or table evidence; the local numeric catalogue has no dedicated S1-5 entries.
tasks.retrieval_intent: Find company- and reporting-year-specific source passages and tables about time-bound and outcome-oriented workforce targets actually disclosed, including diversity or safety targets, baselines where stated, target dates, population boundaries, progress, and worker involvement in target setting.
tasks.generation_intent: Draft an ESRS S1-style disclosure section about targets related to own-workforce impacts, risks and opportunities using only evidence supplied for the case, preserving its factual qualifications.
claim_risk_notes: An ambition or policy commitment is not automatically a time-bound outcome target.
Preserve leadership-level and geographic boundaries.
Do not confuse a current result with a future target.
Do not invent baseline values, worker participation or external validation.
Separate target progress from causal effectiveness; preserve revisions to metric definitions.

tasks.task_scope: Health and safety management-system coverage, work-related fatalities, recordable accidents and their rates, work-related ill health and days lost, with worker category, metric definition and reporting period preserved.
tasks.task_selection_rationale: Provides a quantitative and boundary-sensitive social task: employees versus non-employees, fatalities versus incidents, and incompatible accident-rate definitions require careful evidence use.
tasks.official_requirement_basis: 2023 Annex I, ESRS S1, paragraphs 86-90; application requirements AR 80-95. Health and safety metrics.
tasks.evidence_availability_rationale: The local catalogue contains 23 indicator definitions, with nonempty extracted cells in 18 of 25 development company-years. These cells require source checking. Historical safety tables and methodology narratives are candidate sources.
tasks.retrieval_intent: Find company- and reporting-year-specific source passages and tables about health and safety management-system coverage, work-related fatalities, recordable accidents and their rates, work-related ill health and days lost, with worker category, metric definition and reporting period preserved.
tasks.generation_intent: Draft an ESRS S1-style disclosure section about health and safety metrics using only evidence supplied for the case, preserving its factual qualifications.
expected_evidence_content: health and safety management system coverage
query_facets: health and safety management system coverage
claim_risk_notes: Do not equate LTIFR, TRIR, high-severity injury rates and ESRS recordable-accident rates.
Preserve rates per 200,000 versus 1,000,000 hours; do not silently convert or relabel.
Distinguish own-workforce non-employees from other workers at sites.
Do not infer zero fatalities or accidents from missing information.
Certification at selected sites does not establish group-wide coverage.
Do not equate accident counts, fatal events and numbers of people killed.
